policy: Every Reddit reply, public-page change, and paid ad requires human review and channel-rule review before manual publication or launch.

review_queue.draft: If your child can start in their own room but returns after waking, treat that as a different moment from refusing the room at bedtime. For several nights, note when the return happens and use one short, predictable response. Avoid changing the room and the routine at the same time, because then it is hard to know what helped. If useful, MyNest has a structured room-transition check; only share a link if this community permits it.

review_queue.proposal: Add a short section distinguishing bedtime room refusal from later-night returns, using repeated language from an approved manual Reddit batch before publication.

review_queue.headline: Find the moment your child's room transition gets stuck
review_queue.body: A two-minute structured Room Check for families preparing an own-room transition. One barrier, one bounded experiment, no medical claims.
